The '''67th [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''' honor the best [[Screenwriter|film, television, radio and video-game writers]] of 2014. The nominations for television, new media, and radio categories were announced on December 4, 2014.<ref name="WGA2015">{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title='Game of Thrones,' 'True Detective,' 'Transparent' Lead WGA TV Nominations|url=https://variety.com/2014/tv/news/writers-guild-tv-nominations-modern-family-true-detective-game-of-thrones-transparent-1201370582/|access-date=January 7, 2015|work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|date=December 4, 2014}}</ref> The nominations for original, adapted, and documentary screenplay nominations were announced on January 7, 2015.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Goodman|first1=Stephanie|title=SEARCH Writers Guild Gives 'Nightcrawler,' 'Whiplash' More Momentum|url=http://carpetbagger.blogs.nytimes.com/2015/01/07/writers-guild-gives-nightcrawler-whiplash-more-momentum/|access-date=January 7, 2015|work=[[The New York Times]]|date=January 7, 2015}}</ref> The winners were announced in simultaneous ceremonies in Los Angeles and New York on February 14, 2015.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://deadline.com/2015/02/wga-award-winners-2015-writers-guild-awards-winners-list-1201373012/ |title=WGA Awards: 'Budapest', 'Imitation Game' Win Top Film Honors, 'True Detective', 'Louie' Score On TV Side — Full List |publisher=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=February 14, 2015 |access-date=February 14, 2015 }}</ref>
